integrity: The proof gives an exact support-by-support formula for every pair of permutation arches. A standalone verifier independently reconstructs the local pair/triple tables, exhausts all normalized second arches through alphabet size 8, and checks all labeled two-arch words for alphabet sizes 4 and 5.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies shortest extremizers only for universality index 2 and alphabet size at least 4. It does not classify longer extremizers or equality cases for universality index at least 3. The extremal count itself is prior; the new content is the equality classification.
title: Unique shortest two-arch extremizers for absent subsequences
